author_name: VLAD HOSTS THE BEST PODCAST IN BITCOIN
html:
I remember losing 100 followers for calling out the bullying tactics of Samourai. Got called a lot of names, people started questioning my integrity.

8 months later, the mob has turned against Samourai & it's safe to take shots at them. I should be amused, but I feel disgusted.

— VLAD HOSTS THE BEST PODCAST IN BITCOIN (@Vladcostea) August 26, 2020
